description: NaSuno Single Source of Truth Knob & Parameter Registry

compositeKnobs.label: CARRIER ERASE
compositeKnobs.moduleSubtitle: Direct removal of embedded AI marks

info.title: Carrier Erase
info.description: Suno and Udio embed inaudible tonal carriers at 15.5, 17.5, and 19.5 kHz. This knob controls the Q-factor of notch filters that surgically suppress these carriers.
info.howItWorks: Three cascaded IIR notch filters at known carrier frequencies. Higher = sharper notch = deeper suppression. Q scales from 4.0 (wide) to 30.0 (surgical).
info.tradeoff: Very high values may create narrow spectral holes. Quality Gate prevents audible damage.

compositeKnobs.label: STRIDE REMOVE
compositeKnobs.moduleSubtitle: Direct removal of embedded AI marks

info.title: Stride Remove
info.description: Neural neural upsamplers leave periodic frame-rate artifacts. This knob controls the comb filter depth and notch attenuation targeting the 172.3 Hz fundamental stride.
info.howItWorks: Harmonic comb filtering and median detrending carve out periodic spikes at neural frame boundaries without affecting surrounding music.
info.tradeoff: Higher values remove more comb energy but could slightly thin low-mid bass if unconstrained.

compositeKnobs.label: STEGO STRIP
compositeKnobs.moduleSubtitle: Direct removal of embedded AI marks

info.title: Stego Strip
info.description: Detects and disrupts micro-echoes (0.5–15 ms) and Quantized Index Modulation (QIM) lattices used to covertly embed metadata.
info.howItWorks: Cepstral inverse filtering removes sub-threshold delays while pseudo-random lattice dither knocks out QIM bit recovery.
info.tradeoff: Moderate values preserve vocal transients; extreme values may introduce micro-dither noise.

compositeKnobs.label: NEURAL SCRUB
compositeKnobs.moduleSubtitle: Direct removal of embedded AI marks

info.title: Neural Scrub
info.defeats: Neural codec spectral residuals & diffusion floor
info.description: Diffusion decoders and neural vocoders leave characteristic high-frequency residual hiss and Wiener floor patterns.
info.howItWorks: Multi-band spectral subtraction and Wiener filtering strip the synthetic noise floor down to natural acoustic baseline.
info.tradeoff: Aggressive settings can cause faint musical noise; controlled by the Wiener spectral floor.

info.title: Spectral Blend
info.description: Audio classifiers analyze energy across Mel filterbanks to fingerprint synthetic audio. This knob blends adjacent Mel bins smoothly.
info.howItWorks: Adaptive median smoothing across 128 Mel bands flattens unnatural energy peaks that trigger classification models.
info.tradeoff: Higher values broaden harmonic peaks slightly; kept transparent by min linear gain limits.

info.title: Phase Scatter
info.description: AI models generate unnaturally coherent phase relationships across frequency bins. Phase Scatter introduces micro-dispersion.
info.howItWorks: Applies transient-safe phase jitter to steady-state bins while strictly preserving attack transients to keep punch crisp.
info.tradeoff: Keeps stereo imaging wide and natural without introducing smearing.

info.title: Stat Normalize
info.description: Synthetic audio exhibits unnatural sample-value distributions and low entropy that forensic statistical tests detect immediately.
info.howItWorks: Injects shaped micro-dither and adjusts first-digit mantissa distributions to conform to Benford's Law and organic entropy curves.
info.tradeoff: Completely transparent to human ears while turning statistical detectors into coin flips.

info.title: Hash Break
info.description: Audio identification databases (Shazam, YouTube ContentID) rely on exact peak-time constellation graphs.
info.howItWorks: Applies sub-perceptual tape wow (cents pitch modulation) and micro-time grid jitter, desynchronizing hash matching.
info.tradeoff: Subtle pitch modulation (< 3 cents) mimics vintage analog tape wow without detuning instruments.

info.title: Room Inject
info.description: Real music recordings possess physical room impulse responses (RIR) and electrical grid (ENF) hum that AI audio lacks.
info.howItWorks: Simulates subtle acoustic room reflections (RT60 50–300 ms), Brownian electrical grid jitter, and micro vocal timing fluctuations.
info.tradeoff: Adds depth and realism. Higher wet mixes sound like live studio rooms.

info.title: Texture Inject
info.description: Physical musical instruments and real vocal cords produce non-linear saturation, micro-breath textures, and bispectral harmonics.
info.howItWorks: LPC residual speech modeling injects micro-textures while bispectral polynomial distortion restores analog tube/tape warm harmonics.
info.tradeoff: Enhances presence and warmth. Excessive levels add vintage drive coloration.

info.title: Bandwidth Heal
info.defeats: Brickwall bandwidth cutoff & missing air frequencies
info.description: AI models often cut off sharply at 16 kHz or 18 kHz. This knob boosts high-frequency air bands and blends comfort noise above cutoff.
info.howItWorks: High-shelf filter at 12 kHz restores high-frequency sheen; comfort noise rolloff gently softens the steep brickwall edge.
info.tradeoff: Restores openness and clarity lost during watermark notch filtering.

info.title: Dynamics
info.description: AI music often has over-compressed or unnaturally static dynamic profiles. This knob calibrates gentle content-seeded master compression.
info.howItWorks: Multi-stage compression ratio (1.02:1 to 1.35:1) with content-seeded attack and release profiles, true peak ceiling, and dither.
info.tradeoff: Ties the track together into a polished commercial master without squashing transients.

info.title: Quality Gate
info.description: Sets the maximum allowed deviation from the original input before the Quality Firewall rolls back processing stages.
info.howItWorks: Monitors Bark-band psychoacoustic limits (ISO 226), stereo correlation, and LUFS loudness. If any stage exceeds limits, it attenuates.
info.tradeoff: Lower dB = strict audiophile preservation; Higher dB = deeper evasion headroom.

info.title: Master Output
info.description: Controls the master Web Audio output gain and export ceiling.
info.howItWorks: Precision decibel-to-linear gain node scaling with soft saturation protection.
info.tradeoff: Use to balance monitoring volume or match pre-processing loudness.
